verses.en: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
verses.pt: Semelhantemente vós, mulheres, sede submissas a vossos maridos; para que também, se alguns deles não obedecem à palavra, sejam ganhos sem palavra pelo procedimento de suas mulheres,
verses.en_web: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;
verses.en_bbe: Wives, be ruled by your husbands; so that even if some of them give no attention to the word, their hearts may be changed by the behaviour of their wives,

verses.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
verses.pt: considerando a vossa vida casta, em temor.
verses.en_web: seeing your pure behavior in fear.
verses.en_bbe: When they see your holy behaviour in the fear of God.

verses.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
verses.pt: O vosso adorno não seja o enfeite exterior, como as tranças dos cabelos, o uso de jóias de ouro, ou o luxo dos vestidos,
verses.en_web: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;
verses.en_bbe: Do not let your ornaments be those of the body such as dressing of the hair, or putting on of jewels of gold or fair clothing;

verses.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God of great price.
verses.pt: mas seja o do íntimo do coração, no incorruptível traje de um espírito manso e tranqüilo, que és, para que permaneçam as coisas
verses.en_web: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.
verses.en_bbe: But let them be those of the unseen man of the heart, the ever-shining ornament of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great price in the eyes of God.

verses.en: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in God, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
verses.pt: Porque assim se adornavam antigamente também as santas mulheres que esperavam em Deus, e estavam submissas a seus maridos;
verses.en_web: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:
verses.en_bbe: And these were the ornaments of the holy women of the past, whose hope was in God, being ruled by their husbands:

verses.en: Even as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
verses.pt: como Sara obedecia a Abraão, chamando-lhe senhor; da qual vós sois filhas, se fazeis o bem e não temeis nenhum espanto.
verses.en_web: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.
verses.en_bbe: As Sarah was ruled by Abraham, naming him lord; whose children you are if you do well, and are not put in fear by any danger.

verses.en: Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.pt: Igualmente vós, maridos, vivei com elas com entendimento, dando honra à mulher, como vaso mais frágil, e como sendo elas herdeiras convosco da graça da vida, para que não sejam impedidas as vossas orações.
verses.en_web: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.
verses.en_bbe: And you husbands, give thought to your way of life with your wives, giving honour to the woman who is the feebler vessel, but who has an equal part in the heritage of the grace of life; so that you may not be kept from prayer.

verses.en: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
verses.pt: Finalmente, sede todos de um mesmo sentimento, compassivos, cheios de amor fraternal, misericordiosos, humildes,
verses.en_web: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tender hearted, courteous,
verses.en_bbe: Last of all, see that you are all in agreement; feeling for one another, loving one another like brothers, full of pity, without pride:

verses.en: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.
verses.pt: não retribuindo mal por mal, ou injúria por injúria; antes, pelo contrário, bendizendo; porque para isso fostes chamados, para herdardes uma bênção.
verses.en_web: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.
verses.en_bbe: Not giving back evil for evil, or curse for curse, but in place of cursing, blessing; because this is the purpose of God for you that you may have a heritage of blessing.

verses.en: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.pt: Pois, quem quer amar a vida, e ver os dias bons, refreie a sua língua do mal, e os seus lábios não falem engano;
verses.en_web: For, “He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.
verses.en_bbe: For it is said, Let the man who has a love of life, desiring to see good days, keep his tongue from evil and his lips from words of deceit:

verses.en: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
verses.pt: aparte-se do mal, e faça o bem; busque a paz, e siga-a.
verses.en_web: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.en_bbe: And let him be turned from evil and do good; searching for peace and going after it with all his heart.

verses.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.
verses.pt: Porque os olhos do Senhor estão sobre os justos, e os seus ouvidos atento à sua súplica; mas o rosto do Senhor é contra os que fazem o mal.
verses.en_web: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”
verses.en_bbe: For the eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

verses.en: And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
verses.pt: Ora, quem é o que vos fará mal, se fordes zelosos do bem?
verses.en_web: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?
verses.en_bbe: Who will do you any damage if you keep your minds fixed on what is good?

verses.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
verses.pt: Mas também, se padecerdes por amor da justiça, bem-aventurados sereis; e não temais as suas ameaças, nem vos turbeis;
verses.en_web: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
verses.en_bbe: But you are happy if you undergo pain because of righteousness; have no part in their fear and do not be troubled;

verses.en: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.pt: antes santificai em vossos corações a Cristo como Senhor; e estai sempre preparados para responder com mansidão e temor a todo aquele que vos pedir a razão da esperança que há em vós;
verses.en_web: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:
verses.en_bbe: But give honour to Christ in your hearts as your Lord; and be ready at any time when you are questioned about the hope which is in you, to give an answer in the fear of the Lord and without pride;

verses.en: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ.
verses.pt: tendo uma boa consciência, para que, naquilo em que falam mal de vós, fiquem confundidos os que vituperam o vosso bom procedimento em Cristo.
verses.en_web: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Being conscious that you have done no wrong; so that those who say evil things about your good way of life as Christians may be put to shame.

verses.en: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
verses.pt: Porque melhor é sofrerdes fazendo o bem, se a vontade de Deus assim o quer, do que fazendo o mal.
verses.en_web: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
verses.en_bbe: Because if it is God's purpose for you to undergo pain, it is better to do so for well-doing than for evil-doing.

verses.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.pt: Porque também Cristo morreu uma só vez pelos pecados, o justo pelos injustos, para levar-nos a Deus; sendo, na verdade, morto na carne, mas vivificado no espírito;
verses.en_web: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;
verses.en_bbe: Because Christ once went through pain for sins, the upright one taking the place of sinners, so that through him we might come back to God; being put to death in the flesh, but given life in the Spirit;

verses.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.pt: no qual também foi, e pregou aos espíritos em prisão;
verses.en_web: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,
verses.en_bbe: By whom he went to the spirits in prison, preaching to those

verses.en: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
verses.pt: os quais noutro tempo foram rebeldes, quando a longanimidade de Deus esperava, nos dias de Noé, enquanto se preparava a arca; na qual poucas, isto é, oito almas se salvaram através da água,
verses.en_web: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.
verses.en_bbe: Who, in the days of Noah, went against God's orders; but God in his mercy kept back the punishment, while Noah got ready the ark, in which a small number, that is to say eight persons, got salvation through water:

verses.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God,) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: que também agora, por uma verdadeira figura - o batismo, vos salva, o qual não é o despojamento da imundícia da carne, mas a indagação de uma boa consciência para com Deus, pela ressurreição de Jesus Cristo,
verses.en_web: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,
verses.en_bbe: And baptism, of which this is an image, now gives you salvation, not by washing clean the flesh, but by making you free from the sense of sin before God, through the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead;

verses.en: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of God; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.pt: que está à destra de Deus, tendo subido ao céu; havendo-se-lhe sujeitado os anjos, e as autoridades, e as potestades.
verses.en_web: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
verses.en_bbe: Who has gone into heaven, and is at the right hand of God, angels and authorities and powers having been put under his rule.
